entities.name: C3a
observations: In a prospective single-center cohort of 126 heart-failure patients undergoing CRT, baseline plasma C3a >165 ng/mL independently predicted 5-year mortality (HR 4.21, 95% CI 1.65–10.72; p=0.003; PMID:27492980).
In the same cohort, median C3a fell from 212.5 to 153 ng/mL at 6 months after CRT (p<0.0001); this treatment-associated change was not shown to predict CRT response.

entities.name: PMID:27492980
observations: Prospective single-center observational study of 126 heart-failure patients receiving CRT; higher pretreatment plasma C3a independently predicted 5-year mortality, but abstract-level evidence does not establish prediction of CRT response, reverse remodeling, or hospitalization.

entities.name: PMID:16884512
observations: An eight-patient CRT study found improved NYHA class and LVEF but no change in complement activation products; it did not evaluate C3a as an outcome predictor.
